brief_summary: This study will evaluate the impact a behavioral intervention can have on BMI. The researchers anticipate the intervention group will experience a decrease in BMI of approximately five points. The intervention group will be compared to a control group. This is a long term, randomized, controlled study. The behavioral intervention is conducted during a four hour monthly session. The behavioral intervention includes: exercise, education on medical aspects and nutrition, and empowerment.
brief_title: Study of Impact of Behavioral Intervention- Exercise, Nutrition, Education- on Body Mass Index (BMI)

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ages 10-20 years
* BMI\>85%

Exclusion Criteria:

* Endocrine disorder
* On psychotropic medications

lead_sponsor.name: Steward St. Elizabeth's Medical Center of Boston, Inc.

official_title: Type 2 Diabetes and Obesity Pediatric Prevention Project

primary_outcomes.measure: Percentage of Participants With BMI Reduction
